documentation: replace returns a copy with occurrences of old changed to new. count can limit how many replacements occur.
inputs: The old substring, replacement substring, and optional count.
caution: Matching is literal and case-sensitive. It is not a regular expression.
scenarios: Update a placeholder in a message template.
Normalize a known delimiter in imported text.
Change a product label in generated descriptions.
title: Fill the customer placeholder
problem: Given an object with template and name strings, replace every exact occurrence of "{name}" in template with name. Leave other placeholders alone.
goal: Use str.replace() or an equivalent approach that demonstrates the same concept.
